rule.text: every witness is refined before it is counted -- not the ones near the floor, all of them
rule.relationship_to_WIT01: WIT-01 is not withdrawn. It stays for the sub-grid case it does catch. Retro-applied it removes nothing -- admissibility ratio 1.000 in all three charts -- because every pair qualifies on a doping magnitude and magnitudes reach the grid exactly, so it is not sufficient either.
rule.why_no_threshold: the observed refinement split sits between 92.2% and 93.65% of the distinguishability floor, 1.4 percentage points. A threshold inside a band that narrow is tuned; PH-11 forbids it. Refining every witness needs no threshold to defend.

supersedes.kept: versions 1 and 2 stay on disk unchanged. Version 1 is the record of the coverage when WIT-02 was enacted; version 2 is the record of it after chart G was closed and while chart L was still the uncovered set.
supersedes.what_moved: chart L only: 0 of 37 refined becomes 37 of 37. Chart G and chart J are untouched.

authorisation: operator directive of 2026-08-28 sections 7 and 8, under fused operator authority. Ladder rung L1 requires every spine item on full coverage; chart L was the only set that was not, and the pilot made a U-BUDGET verdict unavailable.

untouched_sets_reproduce_version_2.why: this register is built by a third implementation of the same match. The two sets that did not move must come out identical, which is what makes the one that did move a measurement rather than a difference between two builders.

verdict.what_changed_since_version_2: chart L: 0 of 37 refined at close, 37 of 37 here, 26 surviving.
verdict.how_to_say_it: WIT-02 is satisfied on all three committed witness sets
verdict.what_full_coverage_does_not_mean: it does not make any d=16 result a separation. Every barrier is still an upper bound along a straight line in one chart's coordinates and the minimum-energy path is still not computed; PATH-01 and AH-13 are untouched by refining witnesses. Full coverage means every counted pair has been through the battery, and nothing more than that.
